title: Ad-hoc sprint drift spotlight (one-off tracker)
content:
Purpose: quick, lightweight spreadsheet to surface sprint-level drift items created ad-hoc during Q3/Q4 2023. Use for weekly sync and for deciding pull-forward vs. defer. Not an authoritative backlog; pointers to primary tickets included where available.

Summary metrics (snapshot 2023-09-15):
- Total rows tracked: 12
- High priority (P0/P1): 3
- Mid priority (P2): 5
- Low/parking (P3): 4
- Owners across Eng/Product/SRE/Solutions.

Table (CSV-style):
ID,Requestor,Area,Priority,Current status,Action owner,Due,Primary ticket/notes
ADH-01,Diego Ramirez,Serving runtime - kv cache,P1,Investigating perf regression,Diego Ramirez,2023-09-22,GH #412 + JIRA-8671 - roll forward small perf patch; needs SRE validation
ADH-02,Amaya Chen,Hosted API - rate limit anomalies,P0,Rolling rollback to previous config,SRE oncall,2023-09-16,JIRA-8729 - spike after policy change; emergency rollback done, postmortem required
ADH-03,Olivia Wang,Console - rollout UI copy,P3,Content draft in progress,Product PM,2023-10-01,Small change for rollout modal, not blocking
ADH-04,Kenji Sato,Dedicated - autoscale policy,P2,Owner assigned,Platform eng,2023-09-30,JIRA-8742 - tune min-replicas for low-util customers
ADH-05,Priya Nair,Private deployment - docs gap,P2,Docs PR open,Docs owner,2023-09-28,CONFLUENCE-priv-deploy-setup + doc PR #58
ADH-06,Maya Lopez,Optimize - batching suggestion,P3,Notebook created,ML engineer,2023-10-15,Ad-hoc perf test; schedule for next cost-optim sprint
ADH-07,Oliver Park,Observability - trace sampling,P1,Sampling prototype deployed,SRE,2023-09-21,JIRA-8690 - affects APM storage costs
ADH-08,Ravi Patel,Solutions - SE pilot capacity,P2,Capacity hold requested,Capacity team,2023-09-25,Temporary reservation for pilot customers
ADH-09,Nadia Hughes,Security - key rotation reminder,P2,Confirm KMS policy,Security eng,2023-09-20,Not customer-impacting but compliance note
ADH-10,Esme Cole,Platform - CI flakes,P1,Hotfix PR open,Release eng,2023-09-18,Test flake increases deploy time; PR #403 in review
ADH-11,Tash Gupta,Customer Success - billing discrepancy,P3,Customer follow-up,Finance ops,2023-09-29,Small invoice mismatch for demo account
ADH-12,Leo Martin,Research infra - GPU queue,P2,Scheduler tweak planned,Infra eng,2023-10-05,Short-term backfill to reduce wait times

Weekly notes (for meeting):
- Focus this week: ADH-02 postmortem and ADH-10 CI flake hotfix. Both are blocking some deploys.
- Capacity note: ADH-08 reservation will consume 2x V100-equivalent slots for 3 weeks if not re-evaluated. Advocate to revert to burst model after pilot start.
- Followups assigned: Diego to confirm perf delta after patch (ADH-01). Oliver to reduce trace retention on staging to validate cost impact (ADH-07).

Decision log snippets:
- 2023-09-16: Emergency rollback for rate-limit config (ADH-02) accepted by SRE/ops leadership; billing impact minimal.
- 2023-09-18: CI hotfix (ADH-10) approved for expedited merge after test coverage check.

How to use: copy row to canonical backlog if the item survives 2 weeks of being 'in progress' and assign a proper JIRA/owner. This sheet intentionally keeps terse notes and pointers only.

Outstanding unknowns / open questions:
- ADH-01: exact SLA delta threshold for failing ABS tests? (Diego)
- ADH-08: will pilot convert to reserved capacity or stay burst? (Capacity team)

Last sync: 2023-09-15 meeting; next sync: ad-hoc until blockers cleared.

Change log:
- 2023-09-15 created by Priya Nair (initial 12 rows)
- 2023-09-16 updated by SRE oncall to mark ADH-02 rollback done
- 2023-09-18 release eng updated ADH-10 status to hotfix PR open
- 2024-01-12 owner refresh and metadata tidy (migrated to Drive sheet format)
